questions.a: Momos is an AI guest experience platform for multi-location restaurant brands. It brings together review management, customer service, surveys, operational insights and local marketing in one place. Its AI copilots help teams respond to guests faster and make better decisions at every location.

questions.q: What new guest AI features launched in 2025?
questions.a: The 2025 releases included AI copilots, AI ticket summaries, AI brand guidelines and AI customer summaries. Operators gained mobile-first reports and incident reports, and marketers gained campaign goal tracking, Google menu management, listings management and social media management. New integrations with Paytronix, Square and Otter connected the platform to more of the restaurant tech stack.

questions.q: What do the AI copilots Alfie and Rockie do?
questions.a: Each copilot takes on a specific part of the guest experience. Alfie answers guest messages, while Rockie monitors location performance and points operators to the root cause of issues. Together they help your team respond faster and act on what guests are saying.

questions.q: What results did restaurant brands see from guest AI in 2025?
questions.a: Brands saved a large amount of manual work, which turned into real cost savings. They also reported better CSAT scores from fixing incidents faster, along with more return visits. Stronger reviews and quicker response times showed up across their locations.

questions.q: What's on the guest AI roadmap for 2026?
questions.a: The plans include more powerful AI copilots, a fully refreshed Unified Inbox and stronger integrations across the restaurant tech stack. You can also expect more operator-focused workflows and new chatbots for websites and apps. The focus stays on driving repeat guests, loyalty and revenue at every location.
